title: China Mountain Hiking Map
synopsis: Explore the beauty of China’s mountain ranges, and experience the culture and natural charm of Mount Tai, Mount Hua, and Mount Emei.

fullText.simplified:
中国爬山地图

    中国是一个多山的国家，在中国旅游，一定会遇到高山。每座山都有故事，这能让爬山变得更有意思。下面的几座山一定不能错过。
    泰山。泰山在中国山东，山东在中国的东边。泰山是一座大山，最高的地方有1545米。虽然听起来不太高，但泰山在中国文化里非常重要。中国皇帝喜欢爬泰山，觉得只有去了泰山才是皇帝。在汉语里，中国人也会叫妻子的爸爸是泰山。在泰山上还可以看到很多有历史、有文化的房子。泰山的日出非常漂亮，一些人喜欢晚上爬泰山，这样第二天早上，就可以在山上看日出了。泰山的冬天很冷，在春、夏、秋三个季节去会好一些。
    华山。华山在中国陕西，陕西在中国的中间。华山也是一座大山，最高的地方有2154米。和泰山一样，华山的冬天特别冷，春、夏、秋三个季节去会好一些。去过华山的人都觉得华山非常漂亮，但是去华山要做好准备，因为华山是中国最“危险”的山，爬华山太难了。和很多山不一样，华山有一些地方是直上直下的。在这些地方，人必须一个一个走，等前面的人走完了，后面的人才能走。喜欢攀岩的人应该会喜欢这些地方，所以不要错过。
    峨眉山。峨眉山在中国四川，四川在中国西南。峨眉山最高的地方有3099米，每个季节都可以去。但是如果你想在冬天去，除了要多穿衣服，也要拿好水和吃的。峨眉山有很多小动物，这些动物常常跑出来，人们会给他们吃的。但是冬天的时候，没有那么多人，如果这些动物饿了，可能会拿走你的水和吃的。峨眉山的日出非常漂亮，但是山上的云特别多，想看日出不太容易。
    除了上面的这几座大山，中国还有黄山、庐山、张家界等，都是爬山的好去处。如果想让身体更好，那就爬山吧！
fullText.traditional:
中國爬山地圖

    中國是一個多山的國家，在中國旅遊，一定會遇到高山。每座山都有故事，這能讓爬山變得更有意思。下面的幾座山一定不能錯過。
    泰山。泰山在中國山東，山東在中國的東邊。泰山是一座大山，最高的地方有1545米。雖然聽起來不太高，但泰山在中國文化裡非常重要。中國皇帝喜歡爬泰山，覺得只有去了泰山才是皇帝。在漢語裡，中國人也會叫妻子的爸爸是泰山。在泰山上還可以看到很多有歷史、有文化的房子。泰山的日出非常漂亮，一些人喜歡晚上爬泰山，這樣第二天早上，就可以在山上看日出了。泰山的冬天很冷，在春、夏、秋三個季節去會好一些。
    華山。華山在中國陝西，陝西在中國的中間。華山也是一座大山，最高的地方有2154米。和泰山一樣，華山的冬天特別冷，春、夏、秋三個季節去會好一些。去過華山的人都覺得華山非常漂亮，但是去華山要做好準備，因為華山是中國最“危險”的山，爬華山太難了。和很多山不一樣，華山有一些地方是直上直下的。在這些地方，人必須一個一個走，等前面的人走完了，後面的人才能走。喜歡攀岩的人應該會喜歡這些地方，所以不要錯過。
    峨眉山。峨眉山在中國四川，四川在中國西南。峨眉山最高的地方有3099米，每個季節都可以去。但是如果你想在冬天去，除了要多穿衣服，也要拿好水和吃的。峨眉山有很多小動物，這些動物常常跑出來，人們會給他們吃的。但是冬天的時候，沒有那麼多人，如果這些動物餓了，可能會拿走你的水和吃的。峨眉山的日出非常漂亮，但是山上的雲特別多，想看日出不太容易。
    除了上面的這幾座大山，中國還有黃山、廬山、張家界等，都是爬山的好去處。如果想讓身體更好，那就爬山吧！

sentences.simplified: 中国是一个多山的国家，在中国旅游，一定会遇到高山。
sentences.traditional: 中國是一個多山的國家，在中國旅遊，一定會遇到高山。

sentences.simplified: 每座山都有故事，这能让爬山变得更有意思。下面的几座山一定不能错过。
sentences.traditional: 每座山都有故事，這能讓爬山變得更有意思。下面的幾座山一定不能錯過。

sentences.english: China is a country with many mountains. When you travel in China, you will most definitely encounter tall mountains.
Every mountain has a story, and this makes climbing the mountains more interesting. These mountains must not be missed:

sentences.english: Mount Tai. Mount Tai is located in Shandong, China. Shandong is located on the east side of China.

sentences.simplified: 虽然听起来不太高，但泰山在中国文化里非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 雖然聽起來不太高，但泰山在中國文化裡非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tīng qǐ lái bù tài gāo dàn tài shān zài zhōng guó wén huà lǐ fēi cháng zhòng yào
sentences.english: Mount Tai is a large mountain. The highest point is at 1,545 meters.

sentences.simplified: 中国皇帝喜欢爬泰山，觉得只有去了泰山才是皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 中國皇帝喜歡爬泰山，覺得只有去了泰山才是皇帝。

sentences.english: Although it doesn’t sound that high, Mount Tai is very important in Chinese culture.

sentences.simplified: 在汉语里，中国人也会叫妻子的爸爸是泰山。
sentences.traditional: 在漢語裡，中國人也會叫妻子的爸爸是泰山。
sentences.pinyin: zài hàn yǔ lǐ zhōng guó rén yě huì jiào qī zi de bà ba shì tài shān
sentences.english: Chinese emperors liked climbing Mount Tai and felt that only after climbing Mount Tai could they be considered emperors.

sentences.simplified: 在泰山上还可以看到很多有历史、有文化的房子。
sentences.traditional: 在泰山上還可以看到很多有歷史、有文化的房子。
sentences.pinyin: zài tài shān shang hái kě yǐ kàn dào hěn duō yǒu lì shǐ yǒu wén huà de fáng zi
sentences.english: In Chinese, Chinese people also call their wife’s father “Mount Tai”.

sentences.simplified: 泰山的日出非常漂亮，
sentences.traditional: 泰山的日出非常漂亮，
sentences.pinyin: tài shān de rì chū fēi cháng piào liang
sentences.english: At Mount Tai, one can also see many houses full of history and culture.

sentences.simplified: 一些人喜欢晚上爬泰山，这样第二天早上，就可以在山上看日出了。
sentences.traditional: 一些人喜歡晚上爬泰山，這樣第二天早上，就可以在山上看日出了。
sentences.pinyin: yì xiē rén xǐ huan wǎn shang pá tài shān zhè yàng dì èr tiān zǎo shang jiù kě yǐ zài shān shang kàn rì chū le
sentences.english: The sunrise on Mount Tai is very beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 泰山的冬天很冷，在春、夏、秋三个季节去会好一些。
sentences.traditional: 泰山的冬天很冷，在春、夏、秋三個季節去會好一些。
sentences.pinyin: tài shān de dōng tiān hěn lěng zài chūn xià qiū sān ge jì jié qù huì hǎo yì xiē
sentences.english: Some people like climbing up Mount Tai at night. This way, they can watch the sunrise on the mountain the next morning.
The winters on Mount Tai are very cold, so it’s better to go there during the three seasons of spring, summer, and autumn.

sentences.traditional: 華山。華山在中國陝西，陝西在中國的中間。
sentences.pinyin: huà shān huà shān zài zhōng guó shǎn xī shǎn xī zài zhōng guó de zhōng jiān

sentences.traditional: 和泰山一樣，華山的冬天特別冷，春、夏、秋三個季節去會好一些。
sentences.pinyin: hé tài shān yí yàng huà shān de dōng tiān tè bié lěng chūn xià qiū sān ge jì jié qù huì hǎo yì xiē
sentences.english: Mount Hua is also a large mountain, with its highest point at 2,154 meters.

sentences.simplified: 去过华山的人都觉得华山非常漂亮，
sentences.traditional: 去過華山的人都覺得華山非常漂亮，
sentences.pinyin: qù guò huà shān de rén dōu jué de huà shān fēi cháng piào liang
sentences.english: Like Mount Tai, the winters of Mount Hua are very cold, so it’s better to go there during the three seasons of spring, summer, and autumn.

sentences.simplified: 但是去华山要做好准备，因为华山是中国最“危险”的山，
sentences.traditional: 但是去華山要做好準備，因為華山是中國最“危險”的山，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì qù huà shān yào zuò hǎo zhǔn bèi yīn wèi huà shān shì zhōng guó zuì wēi xiǎn de shān
sentences.english: People who have been to Mount Hua think that Mount Hua is very beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 爬华山太难了。
sentences.traditional: 爬華山太難了。
sentences.pinyin: pá huà shān tài nán le
sentences.english: However, you must be prepared if you are going to Mount Hua because Mount Hua is China’s most “dangerous” mountain.

sentences.simplified: 和很多山不一样，华山有一些地方是直上直下的。
sentences.traditional: 和很多山不一樣，華山有一些地方是直上直下的。
sentences.pinyin: hé hěn duō shān bù yí yàng huà shān yǒu yì xiē dì fang shì zhí shàng zhí xià de
sentences.english: It is very difficult to climb Mount Hua.

sentences.simplified: 在这些地方，人必须一个一个走，等前面的人走完了，后面的人才能走。
sentences.traditional: 在這些地方，人必須一個一個走，等前面的人走完了，後面的人才能走。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè xiē dì fang rén bì xū yí ge yí ge zǒu děng qián miàn de rén zǒu wán le hòu miàn de rén cái néng zǒu
sentences.english: Unlike many other mountains, Mount Hua has a lot of places that are straight up and down.

sentences.simplified: 喜欢攀岩的人应该会喜欢这些地方，所以不要错过。
sentences.traditional: 喜歡攀岩的人應該會喜歡這些地方，所以不要錯過。
sentences.pinyin: xǐ huan pān yán de rén yīng gāi huì xǐ huan zhè xiē dì fang suǒ yǐ bú yào cuò guò
sentences.english: In these places, people must go one by one, waiting for the person in front to finish before the next person can proceed.
People who like rock climbing will probably enjoy these places, so don’t miss out.

sentences.traditional: 峨眉山。峨眉山在中國四川，四川在中國西南。
sentences.pinyin: é méi shān é méi shān zài zhōng guó sì chuān sì chuān zài zhōng guó xī nán

sentences.traditional: 但是如果你想在冬天去，除了要多穿衣服，也要拿好水和吃的。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng zài dōng tiān qù chú le yào duō chuān yī fu yě yào ná hǎo shuǐ hé chī de
sentences.english: Mount Emei’s highest point is 3,099 meters. It can be visited during all seasons.

sentences.simplified: 峨眉山有很多小动物，这些动物常常跑出来，人们会给他们吃的。
sentences.traditional: 峨眉山有很多小動物，這些動物常常跑出來，人們會給他們吃的。
sentences.pinyin: é méi shān yǒu hěn duō xiǎo dòng wù zhè xiē dòng wù cháng cháng pǎo chu lai rén men huì gěi tā men chī de
sentences.english: However, if you want to go in the winter, aside from wearing more layers of clothing, you should also bring water and food.

sentences.simplified: 但是冬天的时候，没有那么多人，如果这些动物饿了，可能会拿走你的水和吃的。
sentences.traditional: 但是冬天的時候，沒有那麼多人，如果這些動物餓了，可能會拿走你的水和吃的。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì dōng tiān de shí hou méi yǒu nà me duō rén rú guǒ zhè xiē dòng wù è le kě néng huì ná zǒu nǐ de shuǐ hé chī de
sentences.english: Mount Emei has many small animals. These animals will often come out, and people will give them food.

sentences.simplified: 峨眉山的日出非常漂亮，但是山上的云特别多，想看日出不太容易。
sentences.traditional: 峨眉山的日出非常漂亮，但是山上的雲特別多，想看日出不太容易。
sentences.pinyin: é méi shān de rì chū fēi cháng piào liang dàn shì shān shang de yún tè bié duō xiǎng kàn rì chū bù tài róng yì
sentences.english: But in the winter, there aren’t that many people, so if these animals get hungry, they might take your water and food.
The sunrise on Mount Emei is very beautiful, but there are many clouds on the mountain, so it’s not that easy to see the sunrise.

sentences.traditional: 中國還有黃山、廬山、張家界等，都是爬山的好去處。

sentences.english: Aside from these large mountains mentioned above, ..

sentences.simplified: 如果想让身体更好，那就爬山吧！
sentences.traditional: 如果想讓身體更好，那就爬山吧！

sentence_translations: China Mountain Hiking Map
China is a country with many mountains. When you travel in China, you will most definitely encounter tall mountains.
Every mountain has a story, and this makes climbing the mountains more interesting. These mountains must not be missed:
Mount Tai. Mount Tai is located in Shandong, China. Shandong is located on the east side of China.
Mount Tai is a large mountain. The highest point is at 1,545 meters.
Although it doesn’t sound that high, Mount Tai is very important in Chinese culture.
Chinese emperors liked climbing Mount Tai and felt that only after climbing Mount Tai could they be considered emperors.
In Chinese, Chinese people also call their wife’s father “Mount Tai”.
At Mount Tai, one can also see many houses full of history and culture.
The sunrise on Mount Tai is very beautiful.
Some people like climbing up Mount Tai at night. This way, they can watch the sunrise on the mountain the next morning.
The winters on Mount Tai are very cold, so it’s better to go there during the three seasons of spring, summer, and autumn.
Mount Hua. Mount Hua is located in Shaanxi, China. Shaanxi is in central China.
Mount Hua is also a large mountain, with its highest point at 2,154 meters.
Like Mount Tai, the winters of Mount Hua are very cold, so it’s better to go there during the three seasons of spring, summer, and autumn.
People who have been to Mount Hua think that Mount Hua is very beautiful.
However, you must be prepared if you are going to Mount Hua because Mount Hua is China’s most “dangerous” mountain.
It is very difficult to climb Mount Hua.
Unlike many other mountains, Mount Hua has a lot of places that are straight up and down.
In these places, people must go one by one, waiting for the person in front to finish before the next person can proceed.
People who like rock climbing will probably enjoy these places, so don’t miss out.
Mount Emei. Mount Emei is located in Sichuan, China. Sichuan is in southwest China.
Mount Emei’s highest point is 3,099 meters. It can be visited during all seasons.
However, if you want to go in the winter, aside from wearing more layers of clothing, you should also bring water and food.
Mount Emei has many small animals. These animals will often come out, and people will give them food.
But in the winter, there aren’t that many people, so if these animals get hungry, they might take your water and food.
The sunrise on Mount Emei is very beautiful, but there are many clouds on the mountain, so it’s not that easy to see the sunrise.
Aside from these large mountains mentioned above, ..
.. China also has Mount Huang, Mount Lu, Zhangjiajie, and so on, which are all great places for hiking.
If you'd like to make your body better, then be sure to go hiking!
